camera_evidence.selection_verdict: Two credible close-range camera kits and one conditional mechanical prototype. No third independently purchasable, manufacturer-supported close-up camera kit was verified. Do not label Blink close-up validated.
design_rules: Whole camera sled should withdraw without opening seed reservoir.
All stated dimensions are manufacturer envelopes, not measured fit. Add adjustable straps/soft pads and fit coupon.
No numerical minimum focus distance found for selected cameras; bench test target/perch distance before final positioning.
Do not put PIR behind normal transparent glazing. Keep lens, PIR, IR LEDs, light sensor unobstructed.

No mirror recommended. Mirror redirects optical path but does not eliminate minimum focusing distance; total path must satisfy focus, and IR reflections/ghosting and PIR separate line of sight need testing.
